purpose: One approved corrective execution after the v2 governance precheck stopped before RUNNING because approval-artifact paths were hard-coded to v1.

approval.scope: One new immutable v2b execution with five fixed parents, five perception meshes, 250 anchors and 750 static views; only runner approval-path resolution changes.
approval.confirmation_reference: 用户在获知 v2 因 runner 硬编码 v1 提案/数据卡路径而没有执行后回复：继续为啥不执行

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research execution only; no source redistribution or modified-source publication.
source.benchmark_exclusion: All M-TARE comparison and underground benchmark worlds remain excluded.

generation.retry_policy: One new run only; no parent retry, alternate seed, replacement or keep-best selection.
generation.variant_policy: One native perception mesh per parent; no navigation qualification claim.

sampling.sensor_contract: Open3D 0.19.0 CPU first-return 16x720 range_m/valid_mask, 0.3--50 m, no noise.
sampling.label_contract: Frozen objective 5 m spline outgoing headings and 720-bin target; graph/splines never enter student arrays.
sampling.storage_contract: Five compressed diagnostic shards, five complete maps and thirty fixed all-observation pages; not a formal dataset.

evidence.machine_metrics: Require spec-bound proposal/data-card hashes and pinned E1 import path before RUNNING, then retain all graph, replay, seed, mesh, anchor, sensor, branch and leakage checks.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Five full world maps and thirty pages cover all 750 views exactly once; no best-case selection.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop and seal on first failure; no automatic retry or scientific configuration change.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only frozen E1; five meshes and 17.28 million primary rays; no GPU, simulator or training.
